```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load the easystats packages.
library(easystats)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(readxl)
# Read the clean_data worksheet.
input_file <- "STA304_Group6_Data_Cleaned.xlsx"
output_dir <- file.path(dirname(input_file), "Part2_Results")
survey_data <- readxl::read_excel(
  input_file,
  sheet = "clean_data"
)
# Define the numerical variables.
commute_vars <- c(
  "commute_time_min",
  "commute_distance_km",
  "commute_cost_cad"
)
rating_vars <- c(
  "transit_preference_1to7",
  "cost_importance_1to7",
  "distance_importance_1to7"
)
mode_labels <- c("Public transit", "Driving", "Passenger/Carpooling",
                 "Walking", "Taxi/Ride-hailing")
vehicle_access_labels <- c("No access", "Vehicle access")
required_vars <- c("studentID", "preferred_mode", "current_mode",
                   "vehicle_access", commute_vars, rating_vars)
missing_columns <- setdiff(required_vars, names(survey_data))
if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop("Missing columns: ", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "))
}
numeric_vars <- c(commute_vars, rating_vars)
if (!all(vapply(survey_data[numeric_vars], is.numeric, logical(1)))) {
  stop("Commute variables and rating variables must be numeric.")
}
analysis_data <- survey_data %>%
  mutate(
    preferred_mode_code = preferred_mode,
    preferred_mode = factor(preferred_mode, levels = 1:5, labels = mode_labels),
    current_mode = factor(current_mode, levels = 1:5, labels = mode_labels),
    vehicle_access = factor(vehicle_access, levels = c(0, 1),
                            labels = vehicle_access_labels)
  )

```
The dataset contains `r nrow(survey_data)` responses and
`r ncol(survey_data)` variables.
There are `r sum(is.na(survey_data))` missing values in total.
```{r checks, include=FALSE}
# Inspect data types and missing values.
str(survey_data)
colSums(is.na(survey_data))
```

## Categorical Frequencies

```{r frequencies}
categorical_vars <- c(
  "preferred_mode", "current_mode", "vehicle_access",
  "transit_preference_1to7", "cost_importance_1to7",
  "distance_importance_1to7"
)
missing_columns <- setdiff(categorical_vars, names(survey_data))
if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  stop("Missing columns: ", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "))
}
validate_codes <- function(x, allowed, variable) {
  invalid <- unique(x[!is.na(x) & !(x %in% allowed)])
  if (length(invalid) > 0) {
    stop(variable, " contains unexpected codes: ",
         paste(invalid, collapse = ", "))
  }
}
for (v in c("preferred_mode", "current_mode")) {
  validate_codes(survey_data[[v]], 1:5, v)
}
validate_codes(survey_data$vehicle_access, c(0, 1), "vehicle_access")
rating_vars <- c(
  "transit_preference_1to7", "cost_importance_1to7",
  "distance_importance_1to7"
)
for (v in rating_vars) {
  validate_codes(survey_data[[v]], 1:7, v)
}
categorical_data <- survey_data
categorical_data$preferred_mode <- factor(
  survey_data$preferred_mode, levels = 1:5, labels = mode_labels
)
categorical_data$current_mode <- factor(
  survey_data$current_mode, levels = 1:5, labels = mode_labels
)
categorical_data$vehicle_access <- factor(
  survey_data$vehicle_access,
  levels = c(0, 1),
  labels = vehicle_access_labels
)
for (v in rating_vars) {
  categorical_data[[v]] <- factor(
    survey_data[[v]], levels = 1:7, ordered = TRUE
  )
}
frequency_table <- function(x) {
  counts <- table(x, useNA = "no")
  valid_n <- sum(counts)
  percentages <- if (valid_n > 0) {
    round(100 * as.numeric(counts) / valid_n, 2)
  } else {
    rep(NA_real_, length(counts))
  }
  data.frame(
    Category = names(counts),
    Frequency = as.integer(counts),
    Percentage = percentages,
    Valid_n = rep(as.integer(valid_n), length(counts)),
    Missing_n = rep(sum(is.na(x)), length(counts)),
    row.names = NULL
  )
}
frequency_tables <- setNames(
  lapply(categorical_vars, function(v) frequency_table(categorical_data[[v]])),
  categorical_vars
)
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
for (v in categorical_vars) {
  cat("\n---", v, "---\n")
  print(frequency_tables[[v]], row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(
    frequency_tables[[v]],
    file.path(output_dir, paste0("Frequency_", v, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}
combined_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(categorical_vars, function(v) {
  data.frame(Variable = v, frequency_tables[[v]], row.names = NULL)
}))
rownames(combined_table) <- NULL
write.csv(combined_table,
          file.path(output_dir, "Part2_All_Frequency_Tables.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
preferred <- frequency_tables$preferred_mode
current <- frequency_tables$current_mode
mode_comparison <- data.frame(
  Transportation_mode = preferred$Category,
  Preferred_n = preferred$Frequency,
  Preferred_percentage = preferred$Percentage,
  Current_n = current$Frequency,
  Current_percentage = current$Percentage
)
cat("\n--- PREFERRED VS CURRENT TRANSPORTATION ---\n")
print(mode_comparison, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(mode_comparison,
          file.path(output_dir, "Part2_Preferred_vs_Current.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
variable_labels <- c(
  preferred_mode = "preferred transportation mode",
  current_mode = "current transportation mode",
  vehicle_access = "private vehicle access",
  transit_preference_1to7 = "public transit preference rating (1-7)",
  cost_importance_1to7 = "travel cost importance rating (1-7)",
  distance_importance_1to7 = "travel distance importance rating (1-7)"
)
describe_frequency <- function(v) {
  tab <- frequency_tables[[v]]
  if (sum(tab$Frequency) == 0) {
    return(paste("No valid responses were available for", variable_labels[[v]]))
  }
  top <- tab[tab$Frequency == max(tab$Frequency), , drop = FALSE]
  categories <- paste(sprintf('"%s"', top$Category), collapse = " and ")
  if (nrow(top) == 1) {
    sprintf(
      "For %s, the most common response was %s, reported by %d respondents (%.2f%% of %d valid responses).",
      variable_labels[[v]], categories, top$Frequency[1],
      top$Percentage[1], top$Valid_n[1]
    )
  } else {
    sprintf(
      "For %s, the most common responses were %s, each reported by %d respondents (%.2f%% of %d valid responses).",
      variable_labels[[v]], categories, top$Frequency[1],
      top$Percentage[1], top$Valid_n[1]
    )
  }
}
interpretations <- vapply(categorical_vars, describe_frequency, character(1))
writeLines(
  c(
    "PART 2: DESCRIPTIVE INTERPRETATIONS", "",
    unname(interpretations), "",
    "Vehicle access coding and grouping:",
    paste(
      "Vehicle access was coded as a binary variable",
      "(0 = no private vehicle access; 1 = private vehicle access).",
      "The grouping follows the cleaned dataset."
    ),
    paste(
      "Drivers and passengers are grouped together because both have access",
      "to a privately owned vehicle, whether as a driver or as a passenger."
    ), "",
    "Percentages use valid responses for each variable and are rounded to two decimal places."
  ),
  file.path(output_dir, "Part2_Interpretations.txt")
)
cat("\n--- DESCRIPTIVE INTERPRETATIONS ---\n")
cat(paste(interpretations, collapse = "\n\n"), "\n")
cat("\nPart 2 completed. Results saved to:\n", output_dir, "\n")
```

## Preferred and Current Transportation Comparison

```{r mode-comparison}
stopifnot(all(c("preferred_mode", "current_mode") %in% names(survey_data)))
for (v in c("preferred_mode", "current_mode")) {
  if (any(!is.na(survey_data[[v]]) & !(survey_data[[v]] %in% 1:5))) {
    stop("Unexpected transportation mode code in ", v)
  }
}
preferred_n <- table(factor(survey_data$preferred_mode, levels = 1:5))
current_n <- table(factor(survey_data$current_mode, levels = 1:5))
if (sum(preferred_n) == 0 || sum(current_n) == 0) {
  stop("Both variables must contain valid responses.")
}
percentages <- rbind(
  Preferred = 100 * as.numeric(preferred_n) / sum(preferred_n),
  Current = 100 * as.numeric(current_n) / sum(current_n)
)
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
pdf(file.path(output_dir, "Preferred_vs_Current_Transportation.pdf"),
    width = 10, height = 6.25, useDingbats = FALSE)
par(mar = c(5, 5, 5.2, 1.2), family = "sans", las = 1,
    col.axis = "#475569", col.lab = "#334155", fg = "#CBD5E1",
    mgp = c(3, 0.8, 0), xaxs = "i", yaxs = "i")
upper <- max(60, ceiling(max(percentages) / 10) * 10 + 10)
positions <- barplot(
  percentages, beside = TRUE, plot = FALSE, space = c(0.12, 0.65)
)
plot.new()
plot.window(xlim = c(0, max(positions) + 0.9), ylim = c(0, upper))
abline(h = seq(0, upper, 10), col = "#E8EDF2", lwd = 1)
barplot(percentages, beside = TRUE, add = TRUE,
        space = c(0.12, 0.65), axes = FALSE, axisnames = FALSE,
        col = c("#4C78A8", "#E69F45"), border = NA)
axis(2, at = seq(0, upper, 10), labels = paste0(seq(0, upper, 10), "%"),
     tick = FALSE, cex.axis = 0.9)
axis(1, at = colMeans(positions),
     labels = c("Public transit", "Driving", "Passenger /\nCarpooling", "Walking", "Taxi /\nRide-hailing"),
     tick = FALSE, cex.axis = 0.85, line = 0.4)
text(positions, percentages + 1.8,
     labels = paste0(formatC(percentages, format = "f", digits = 2), "%"),
     cex = 0.83, col = "#334155")
mtext("Respondents (%)", side = 2, line = 3.5, las = 0, col = "#334155", cex = 0.9)
mtext("Preferred vs. Current Transportation to UTM", side = 3, line = 3.4,
      adj = 0, font = 2, col = "#172B4D", cex = 1.2)
mtext(sprintf("Preferred: n = %d | Current: n = %d", sum(preferred_n), sum(current_n)),
      side = 3, line = 2.1, adj = 0, col = "#64748B", cex = 0.85)
legend("topright", legend = c("Preferred mode", "Current mode"),
       fill = c("#4C78A8", "#E69F45"), border = NA,
       bty = "n", horiz = TRUE, cex = 0.85, text.col = "#334155")
dev.off()
cat("Chart saved to:", normalizePath(output_dir), "\n")
```

## Statistical Analysis

```{r statistical-analysis}
# Summary statistics for quantitative variables 
numeric_vars <- c("commute_time_min", "commute_distance_km", "commute_cost_cad",
                 "transit_preference_1to7", "cost_importance_1to7",
                 "distance_importance_1to7")
quant_summary <- datawizard::describe_distribution(
  analysis_data, select = numeric_vars, centrality = c("mean", "median")
) |>
  select(-any_of(c("Skewness", "Kurtosis", "n_Missing", "MAD")))
print(knitr::kable(quant_summary, caption = "Quantitative variable summaries"))
# Frequency tables - qualitative variables
print(datawizard::data_tabulate(
  analysis_data, c("preferred_mode", "current_mode", "vehicle_access")
))
# RQ1: What modes of transportation do STA304H5 students prefer when commuting to campus? 
rq1_counts <- analysis_data %>%
  count(preferred_mode, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(percentage = round(100 * n / sum(n), 2))
print(knitr::kable(rq1_counts, caption = "Preferred transportation modes"))
p_rq1_basic <- ggplot(analysis_data, aes(x = preferred_mode)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(title = "Preferred Transportation Modes Among STA304H5 Students",
       x = "Preferred Transportation Mode", y = "Number of Students") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1))
print(p_rq1_basic)
# One-sample proportion test: public transit = preferred_mode code 1.
# H0: p = 0.50; HA: p != 0.50; alpha = 0.05.
rq1_transit_n <- sum(analysis_data$preferred_mode_code == 1, na.rm = TRUE)
rq1_valid_n <- sum(!is.na(analysis_data$preferred_mode_code))
rq1_proportion <- rq1_transit_n / rq1_valid_n
cat("RQ1: public transit count =", rq1_transit_n, "; valid n =", rq1_valid_n,
    "; sample proportion =", round(rq1_proportion, 4), "\n")
rq1_test <- prop.test(x = rq1_transit_n, n = rq1_valid_n, p = 0.5,
                      alternative = "two.sided", correct = FALSE)
print(rq1_test)
# Extract statistical results, report::report(rq1_test) does not support proportion test
rq1_test$estimate
rq1_test$statistic
rq1_test$parameter
rq1_test$p.value
rq1_test$conf.int
# RQ2: Does mean transit preference differ by vehicle access?
rq2_group_stats <- analysis_data %>%
  group_by(vehicle_access) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(!is.na(transit_preference_1to7)),
            mean = mean(transit_preference_1to7, na.rm = TRUE),
            median = median(transit_preference_1to7, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd = sd(transit_preference_1to7, na.rm = TRUE),
            IQR = IQR(transit_preference_1to7, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
print(knitr::kable(rq2_group_stats, digits = 2))
boxplot(transit_preference_1to7 ~ vehicle_access, data = analysis_data,
        main = "Public Transit Preference by Vehicle Access",
        xlab = "Access to a Private Vehicle",
        ylab = "Public Transit Preference Rating (1-7)")
p_rq2_qq <- ggplot(analysis_data, aes(sample = transit_preference_1to7)) +
  stat_qq() + stat_qq_line() +
  facet_wrap(~ vehicle_access) +
  labs(title = "Q-Q Plots of Transit Preference by Vehicle Access",
       x = "Theoretical Quantiles", y = "Sample Quantiles") +
  theme_minimal()
print(p_rq2_qq)
# Exploratory diagnostic plots for a two-group linear model.
rq2_model <- lm(transit_preference_1to7 ~ vehicle_access, data = analysis_data)
print(performance::check_model(rq2_model,
                               check = c("qq", "normality", "linearity", "homogeneity")))
# Welch's t-test allows different variances in the two groups.
# H0: mean(No access) = mean(Vehicle access)
rq2_test <- t.test(transit_preference_1to7 ~ vehicle_access,
                   data = analysis_data, alternative = "two.sided")
rq2_test
report::report(rq2_test)
# RQ3: How are factors such as commute cost, commute time, and commute distance 
# associated with students’ influence on public transportation preference?
p_rq3_time_basic <- ggplot(analysis_data, aes(x = commute_time_min,
                       y = transit_preference_1to7)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  labs(title = "Transit Preference and Commute Time",
       x = "Commute Time (minutes)",
       y = "Public Transit Preference Rating (1-7)") +
  theme_minimal()
print(p_rq3_time_basic)
# Multiple linear regression
# H0 (overall F-test): beta_time = beta_cost = beta_distance = 0
rq3_model <- lm(transit_preference_1to7 ~ commute_time_min +
              commute_cost_cad + commute_distance_km,
            data = analysis_data)
# Check assumptions and diagnostic plots, then report.
print(performance::check_model(
  rq3_model, check = c("qq", "normality", "linearity", "homogeneity")
))
print(performance::check_collinearity(rq3_model))
print(summary(rq3_model))
report::report(rq3_model)
```
